- **Where it came from:** Hollis named it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026 as the ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he could see that himself.

A ticket number is an operational fact, so it was fine to post in the channel.
